sentences.text: for the IT Club's online magazine.
Listen to the interview and complete the answers below.
Please note that you do not need to answer in complete sentences.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task, you will have three minutes to tidy up your answers.
Dr
Berg. thank you for taking the time to meet us today.
Can you tell us a bit about the ideas behind Tarako Solutions?
Certainly. While Tarako Solutions is an NGO as you probably know.
And we operate in poor and remote areas all over the world.
We work in these areas to solve local problems, infrastructure structure problems mainly.
Oh, really, that’s quite interesting.
What kind of infrastructure problems?
Well, maybe I can illustrate what we do with a recent redevelopment project in Thailand we were working on where we built a new bus shelter for a group of commuters.
This helped local people deal with an uncomfortable journey to work and school.
And other projects designed for special groups of people?
Actually, it's the opposite.
We really try to embrace diversity in everything we do.
So we always try to invite, you know, people who are often overlooked in traditional society.
Very often it's these kind of people that don’t get to have their say.
OK. now I'd like Sorry.
I was going to add, when we're building things like the bus shelter, we invite ideas from the children as they are the users who are often overlooked.
Well, that all sounds very positive.
I'd like to move on to how to Racco Solutions uses technology.
You work with AR augmented reality is that right?
Yes, that’s right.
AR mixes digital elements with real life.
It sounds quite technical.
It’s the same tech used in the game Pokémon Go, but instead of a monster, you can see things like a new bridge or a staircase.
AR is great, I mean, we can literally see the designs as they would appear in real life.
Amazing. And another thing about AR is that it lets other people see which final designs say like best.
This is important because in order to choose the final design, we have a public vote, Right, now AR is new to me.
So I imagine this is probably a new concept for most of the people you're dealing with.
So how do you deal with that?
Well, that’s a good point.
Everybody who's selected to join the project must attend a three -day AR training program.
OK. And for some users it’s actually the first time they've ever used the computer, so it's an essential part of the process.
Can you tell us what your favourite project has been so far?
I think one of the most memorable developments has been the Kerala project in India.
OK, and what did that entail?
Well. this was a project designed to improve a riverside path to a market There were several things we had to address.
We had to build in safety measures into the design to help deal with flash floods for a start.
That was important Plus, one special thing about this project was that the children who used the route gave us important information.
tests, especially snakes.
So again we built in features to deal with that.
Right. This project also taught us a lot about building truss.
And in many of the locals were quite doubtful at first.
Did they explain why?
Yes, they did.
They told us about a similar project in the village a few years before that
project. That it wouldn't be finished either.
Precisely. Which I think is fair enough.
I think it was a genuine concern.
The other reason why they were quite doubtful about it was to do with what would happen after we left.
They were worried that there would be no one to maintain the path once we'd gone.
Again, enough a genuine worry.
So how did you change their minds?
Well, we had to convince them that we aren't just another temporary volunteer project.
That we wouldn't just leave.
What really helped was another piece of technology one that could continue to support the Kerala Project long after construction had finished Oh yeah?
And what was that?
Well, we set up webcams that deliver a live fee 24 hours a day on our web page.
It’s a win -win for everyone.
It means that for local users, we can easily see areas where the path is deteriorated.
The webcams are great for that.
So, it’s been a great success.
And for Teraco Solutions?
What were the benefits?
You said it was a win -win situation, Oh yes, sorry, it also means that we at Teraco Solutions can get more funding as we promote our work online using the images.
OK. thank you so much for turning us about to reco Solutions today.
